mintAuthority.summary: IAUon uses issuer-controlled minting across Ethereum, BSC, HyperEVM, and Solana. The three EVM tokens are BeaconProxy deployments whose shared Ondo beacons are upgradeable through 2-hour TimelockControllers; on BSC and HyperEVM those timelocks propose via a 4-of-7 Ondo Safe, execute/cancel via a 1-of-9 Ondo Safe plus one EOA, and are administered by a 5-of-9 Ondo Safe. Direct minters are the per-chain GMTokenManager (administered by the chain timelock) and the per-chain OndoOFT (owned by an OndoOwner contract whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the 4-of-7 Safe). On Solana the mint authority is the Ondo GM program PDA and the GM program's upgrade authority is a bare system account whose off-chain key custody is not on-chain verifiable.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (Ethereum) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c; Blockscout source: GMTokenManager. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets.

controls.label: OndoOFT (Ethereum) — LayerZero cross-chain minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) = 0x8ffe0da486a4075e7bbb5763fad4732d41f9667c; Blockscout source: OndoOFT. This contract enables LayerZero-based cross-chain mint/burn for IAUon.

controls.label: IAUon deployment-wide beacon-owner timelocks
controls.evidence: Ethereum, BSC, and HyperEVM IAUon tokens resolve through UpgradeableBeacon contracts 0x985462c9..., 0xc046b05a..., and 0x258269e7.... Their owners are distinct TimelockControllers with 7,200-second delays. Follow-up enumeration on 2026-07-27: at BSC block 112486221 and HyperEVM block 41384559, both the BSC timelock 0x8860bbfc7a83e4788a981f4e9f30878331413b26 and the HyperEVM timelock 0x6253fbc5bcf4f49c80745694366f05d6c7be0e83 report getMinDelay() = 7,200 seconds, sole PROPOSER_ROLE member = Safe 0xa307e57ca7f9712af3557af8c5624bef214aa913 (Safe 1.4.1+L2 proxy, master copy 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762, threshold 4-of-7, identical owner set on both chains), EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE = a 1-of-9 Safe (0x80120c4d44ffd6f86716fd8dacd5e395d8bbbe97 on BSC, 0xd484422208b1020c83a155336d2b13ce883e5a21 on HyperEVM) plus EOA 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b, and external DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member = Safe 0xa3a3c71380128972f172ff4052af7b6405da6364 (threshold 5-of-9, identical owners on both chains). Solana is outside this EVM control.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (BSC) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At BSC block 112486221, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) on the BSC IAUon token returned this contract; its sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member is the BSC 2-hour timelock 0x8860bbfc7a83e4788a981f4e9f30878331413b26. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets on BSC.

controls.label: OndoOFT (BSC) — LayerZero cross-chain minter
controls.evidence: At BSC block 112486221, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) on the BSC IAUon token returned this OFT; endpoint() = LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and owner() = OndoOwner 0x4d4e562d6882dc523b8d629d2e9df9230b699933 (same verified OndoOwner.sol pattern as HyperEVM), whose sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member is the 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57ca7f9712af3557af8c5624bef214aa913.

controls.label: OndoOFT (HyperEVM) — sole local minter
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 41384559, this OFT is the sole MINTER_ROLE member of the HyperEVM IAUon token. Its owner() = OndoOwner 0x2e59565b98ec5339cb9767ddb903d9b1e2127e5d (hyperscan-verified OndoOwner.sol, AccessControlEnumerable): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MESSENGER_ADMIN_ROLE resolve to the 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57ca7f9712af3557af8c5624bef214aa913, INSPECTOR_ADMIN_ROLE to the 1-of-9 Safe 0xd484422208b1020c83a155336d2b13ce883e5a21, and RATE_LIMITER_ADMIN_ROLE to EOA 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b.

controls.label: Ondo GM Solana program mint authority PDA
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 435577237, the IAUon Token-2022 mint M77ZvkZ8zW5udRbuJCbuwSwavRa7bGAZYMTwru8ondo reports mint authority 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD, a program-derived address with no keypair (no SOL account). Recent mint transactions invoke the Ondo GM Solana program XzTT4XB8m7sLD2xi6snefSasaswsKCxx5Tifjondogm, which signs through this PDA; the mint's freeze authority is Ondo's 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK (a bare system account).

controls.label: Ondo GM Solana program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 435577237, the Ondo GM program XzTT4XB8m7sLD2xi6snefSasaswsKCxx5Tifjondogm is a BPFUpgradeableLoader program whose program-data account F4F1ZdqwmT4KfCfCnXrqLp9R6Liq4vEqJcs64xVKTKeU records upgrade authority 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM (program last deployed at slot 429073863). That authority is a bare system account (~13.19 SOL, no program), i.e. a single-key-class authority whose off-chain custody (single key, HSM, or MPC) is not verifiable on-chain. It can replace the program that controls the mint-authority PDA.

review.evidence: The prior immutable/no-proxy ruling is superseded. Sourcify and EIP-1967 beacon-slot reads show that the Ethereum, BSC, and HyperEVM IAUon tokens are BeaconProxy deployments using Ondo's shared upgradeable beacons, whose owner timelocks each report a 7,200-second delay. Follow-up enumeration on 2026-07-27 closes the remaining deployment-control gaps: at BSC block 112486221 the BSC token's MINTER_ROLE members are GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 (whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the BSC timelock) and OFT 0xeb8ceb319463fdc97f7860211042e2e1abc81f88 (owner OndoOwner 0x4d4e562d6882dc523b8d629d2e9df9230b699933, whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57ca7f9712af3557af8c5624bef214aa913), and the BSC token's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the BSC timelock. At HyperEVM block 41384559 the sole minter is OFT 0xce61f9246755cc399fd7f37d6b3478590b75aace owned by hyperscan-verified OndoOwner 0x2e59565b98ec5339cb9767ddb903d9b1e2127e5d (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MESSENGER_ADMIN = 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57c, INSPECTOR_ADMIN = 1-of-9 Safe 0xd4844222, RATE_LIMITER_ADMIN = EOA 0xff1621ee). On both BSC and HyperEVM the 7,200-second beacon-owner TimelockControllers propose via the 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57c, execute/cancel via a 1-of-9 Safe plus EOA 0xff1621ee, and are administered by the 5-of-9 Safe 0xa3a3c71380128972f172ff4052af7b6405da6364 (identical owner sets on both chains). At finalized Solana slot 435577237 the Token-2022 mint authority is the Ondo GM program PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD (program XzTT4XB8m7sLD2xi6snefSasaswsKCxx5Tifjondogm) and the program's BPF upgrade authority is the bare system account 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM, whose off-chain key custody is not on-chain verifiable — this caps confidence at probable. Ankura's daily assets-and-liabilities verification remains valid backing evidence.
